404.title: Path Dissolved into the Void
404.description: The coordinates you seek have grown faint in this dimension. Perhaps the map has shifted, or the trail you followed was but a mirage.

500.title: A Fleeting Cosmic Rift
500.description: The celestial alignment has momentarily faltered. Even the most sacred Sanctuary requires a deep breath for healing.

title: The flow of wisdom is veiled in mist.
description: Even in the clearest Sanctuary, fog sometimes rises. We are refocusing the path for your journey, please wait a moment.
supportPrompt: If the mist does not clear, please pass this resonance signature to the Sages.
fallbackMessage: A temporary distortion found in the threads of the cosmos.
